title: 意外的急刹车
subject: 物理
voteQuestion: 五人中，谁明确声称自己在制动前没有超过50 km/h限速，而这句话与本案物理重建结果矛盾？
background: 傍晚，限速50 km/h的城市外围道路发生追尾。蓝色轿车A在前、灰色厢式车B在后，同向同车道。事故无可用监控视频，人员无伤，车辆已移至安全位置。学生在封闭的现场模拟区和调查指挥室调查保存的记录。
briefing: 本课堂只判定：谁的明确限速陈述与物理重建结果矛盾。
不判定法律责任、事故唯一原因或是否故意说谎。
必要证据均可在最终投票前取得；仅一轮最终投票。
建议流程：简报5′ → 现场搜证10′ → 访谈10′ → 物理分析25′ → 指认与复盘10′。

hostNpc.name: 调查主持人
hostNpc.greeting: 欢迎来到调查指挥室。完成现场搜证、访谈与物理分析后，等老师开启投票，再来找我提交最终指认。
hostNpc.votePrompt: 老师已开启最终投票。请选择一人并填写证据与科学依据。每组只能提交一次。

suspects.name: 前车司机A
suspects.card: 明确声称记得制动前未超过50 km/h。

mockQA.q: 事故前你的车速大约多少？
mockQA.a: 我记得制动前没有超过限速50。当时路况还可以。
我好像看到有东西往车道跑……不太确定，可能是小动物。我本能踩了刹车。
我觉得没有。我一向比较注意限速牌。

mockQA.q: 碰撞时你的车是什么状态？
mockQA.a: 我感觉自己几乎刹停了，然后就被后面撞了一下。
人的记忆有时会模糊……但我当时心里是按限速开的。具体数字要以记录为准吧。

suspects.name: 后车司机B
suspects.card: 觉得自己不快但承认跟车近。

mockQA.a: 我觉得自己不快，但承认跟得有点近。前面突然急刹，我反应过来就踩刹了。
我没有刻意超速。具体速度我没法精确说，仪表我没盯着看。
说不清，就是感觉近。出事以后才意识到可能不够。
看到前车刹车灯亮了之后。可能有一点反应延迟。
他刹得挺急的。至于他当时多快，我判断不了。

suspects.name: 目击者C
suspects.card: 听到车辆接近后转头，看到疑似小动物往车道跑，随后听到急刹和碰撞。

mockQA.a: 我先听见车靠近，转头后好像看到有个小动物往车道跑，接着就是急刹和碰撞声。
不能。我没法精确测速，只是目击顺序印象。
不确定，只是疑似小动物。不能当作已证实事实。
听起来前车先急刹，随后碰撞。细节要以现场记录为准。
公交站附近，不在车道上。

suspects.name: 路边店员D
suspects.card: 听到急刹与撞击后才靠近。

mockQA.q: 你亲眼看到事故过程吗？
mockQA.a: 没有。我是听见急刹和撞击后才出来靠近的。
不能。我没有看到事故前的行驶过程。
两车已经停着，有人在打电话。具体痕迹要看勘查记录。
店里监控角度不覆盖这段车道，帮不上忙。

mockQA.q: 气味或声音还有印象吗？
mockQA.a: 就是很响的刹停和砰的一声，然后安静下来。

suspects.name: 候车人E
suspects.card: 事故前主观觉得B跟车近，事故后拍有静止车辆照片。

mockQA.a: 主观感觉后面那辆跟得比较近，但我说不出具体米数或速度。
事故后拍了静止车辆的照片，不能用来测事故前速度。
不能。我没有测速能力，也不该被当成速度证人。
我没注意那个，主要看车。
照片里能看到最终静止位置，精确数据以勘查标记为准。

evidence.name: A车质量
evidence.studentText: 蓝色轿车A质量 m_A = 1000 kg。

evidence.name: B车质量
evidence.studentText: 灰色厢式车B质量 m_B = 1500 kg。

evidence.name: A制动位移
evidence.studentText: A制动开始至碰撞的位移 s_A = 25 m。

evidence.name: 碰撞后共同滑行距离
evidence.studentText: 碰撞后两车共同滑行 6 m。
evidence.teacherNote: 用于共同速度与能量核查。

evidence.name: 记录仪事件时间摘要
evidence.studentText: 记录仪视频损坏，但保留事件时间戳记录（可用于核对时序）。
evidence.teacherNote: 不提供事故前速度直接读数。

evidence.name: A制动至碰撞时间
evidence.studentText: A制动开始至碰撞历时 Δt_A = 2.5 s。

evidence.name: A减速度大小
evidence.studentText: A制动减速度大小 a_A = 8 m/s²（取绝对值）。

evidence.name: B减速度大小
evidence.studentText: B制动减速度大小 a_B = 2 m/s²。

evidence.name: B制动启动延迟
evidence.studentText: 相对A开始制动，B制动启动延迟 1.5 s。

evidence.name: 共同减速度大小
evidence.studentText: 碰撞后共同滑行减速度大小 a_c = 3 m/s²。

evidence.name: 碰撞模型假设
evidence.studentText: 采用一维完全非弹性碰撞近似（碰撞后共速）。
evidence.teacherNote: 模型局限需在复盘说明。

evidence.name: 计算结果：A速度
evidence.studentText: 由学生计算提交：A制动前约 20 m/s，碰撞前约 0 m/s。
evidence.teacherCheck: 20 m/s = 72 km/h > 50 km/h；2.5 s 内以 8 m/s² 制动位移 25 m 刚好停止。

evidence.name: 计算结果：B碰撞瞬时速度
evidence.studentText: 由学生计算提交：B碰撞瞬时约 10 m/s。
evidence.teacherCheck: 由动量守恒与共同速度反推。

evidence.name: 计算结果：B初速与净间距
evidence.studentText: 由学生计算提交：B制动前约 12 m/s；初始净间距约 4 m。
evidence.teacherCheck: 12 m/s=43.2 km/h；B前1.5s行驶18m，后1s行驶11m，总29m；净间距29-25=4m。29m为临界初始间距（本题参数）。

calcTasks.title: Alpha 运动建模
calcTasks.prompt: 利用 E04、E07、E08，求 A 制动前速度 v_A0 与碰撞前速度。

calcTasks.title: Beta 碰撞分析
calcTasks.prompt: 利用质量、共同滑行与完全非弹性假设，求碰撞后共同速度与 B 碰撞瞬时速度。

calcTasks.title: Gamma 能量核查
calcTasks.prompt: 估算模型中碰撞机械能损失（参考量级）。

calcTasks.title: Delta 相对运动
calcTasks.prompt: 求 B 制动前速度与初始净间距。注意：29 m 仅为本题参数下的临界初始间距。

stages.name: 第二幕
stages.teacherHint: 可开放校准事件日志与A减速度鉴定。

stages.name: 第三幕
stages.teacherHint: 可开放B侧参数与碰撞模型假设。

revealSummary.headline: 标准答案：前车司机A
points: A制动前速度重建为 20 m/s = 72 km/h，与其“未超过50 km/h”的明确陈述矛盾。
B制动前约 12 m/s = 43.2 km/h，模型中未超速；初始净间距约 4 m。
29 m 是本题固定参数下的临界初始间距，不是通用安全车距。
猫/小动物仅有证词支持，不能由物理计算证明A当时看见了它。
本投票只判定限速陈述与模型冲突，不判法律责任。

en.title: The Unexpected Hard Brake
en.subject: Physics
en.voteQuestion: Of the five people, who explicitly claimed they were not exceeding the 50 km/h limit before braking, in a statement that contradicts this case’s physics reconstruction?
en.background: At dusk, a rear-end collision happened on an outer-city road with a 50 km/h limit. Blue car A was ahead and gray van B was behind, same direction and same lane. There is no usable surveillance video, no one was injured, and the vehicles have been moved to a safe spot. Students investigate the preserved records in a closed scene mockup and in the investigation command room.
briefing: This class only decides whose explicit speed-limit statement contradicts the physics reconstruction.
It does not decide legal liability, the sole cause of the crash, or whether anyone lied on purpose.
Every piece of evidence you need can be collected before the final vote. There is only one final vote.
Suggested flow: briefing 5′ → scene search 10′ → interviews 10′ → physics analysis 25′ → accusation and review 10′.

hostNpc.name: Investigation host
hostNpc.greeting: Welcome to the command room. After the scene search, interviews, and physics analysis, wait until the teacher opens voting, then come back to me to submit the final accusation.
hostNpc.votePrompt: The teacher has opened the final vote. Choose one person and fill in the evidence and the scientific reasoning. Each group may submit only once.

A.name: Lead driver A
A.card: Explicitly claims to remember not exceeding 50 km/h before braking.

mockQA.q: About how fast were you before the crash?
mockQA.a: I remember not exceeding the 50 limit before I braked. The road was all right at the time.
I thought I saw something run into the lane… I’m not sure. It might have been a small animal. I hit the brakes by instinct.

mockQA.q: Are you sure you were not speeding?
mockQA.a: I don’t think so. I usually pay attention to the speed-limit signs.

mockQA.q: What state was your car in at impact?
mockQA.a: I felt I had almost stopped, and then the car behind hit me.

mockQA.q: Could you have misremembered the speed?
mockQA.a: Memory can be fuzzy… but I believed I was driving at the limit. The records should settle the exact number.

B.name: Following driver B
B.card: Felt they were not going fast, but admits to following closely.

mockQA.a: I didn’t think I was fast, but I admit I was following a bit close. The car ahead braked hard, and I braked as soon as I reacted.
I wasn’t trying to speed. I can’t give an exact speed. I wasn’t watching the gauge.

mockQA.q: About how close were you following?
mockQA.a: Hard to say. It felt close. I only realized afterward that it might not have been enough.
After I saw the lead car’s brake lights. There may have been a short reaction delay.

mockQA.q: What do you think of the lead car?
mockQA.a: They braked very hard. I can’t judge how fast they were going.

C.name: Witness C
C.card: Turned after hearing a vehicle approach, saw what looked like a small animal run toward the lane, then heard a hard brake and a collision.

mockQA.a: I first heard a car approaching. When I turned, I thought I saw a small animal run toward the lane, then a hard brake and a collision.
No. I can’t measure speed. I only have an impression of the order of events.

mockQA.q: Are you sure it was a cat?
mockQA.a: No. It only looked like a small animal. That is not an established fact.
It sounded like the lead car braked hard first, then the collision. The scene record should settle the details.
Near the bus stop, not in the lane.

D.name: Roadside clerk D
D.card: Came closer only after hearing the hard brake and the impact.

mockQA.q: Did you see the crash happen?
mockQA.a: No. I came out only after I heard the hard brake and the impact.
No. I did not see the driving before the crash.

mockQA.q: Was anything unusual at the scene?
mockQA.a: Both vehicles were already stopped, and someone was on the phone. The survey record covers the marks.
The shop camera does not cover this stretch of lane, so it can’t help.

mockQA.q: Any other impression of the sound?
mockQA.a: A loud skid and a bang, then it went quiet.

E.name: Waiting passenger E
E.card: Subjectively felt that B was following closely before the crash, and photographed the stopped vehicles afterward.

mockQA.q: What did you notice before the crash?
mockQA.a: I subjectively felt the rear vehicle was following quite close, but I can’t give a distance or a speed.
I photographed the stopped vehicles after the crash. That photo cannot measure the speed before the crash.

mockQA.q: Can you prove who was speeding?
mockQA.a: No. I can’t measure speed, and I should not be treated as a speed witness.

mockQA.q: Did you see a small animal?
mockQA.a: I didn’t notice that. I was looking at the vehicles.

mockQA.q: Where did the two vehicles finally stop?
mockQA.a: The photo shows the final stopped positions. Exact figures should follow the survey marks.

E01.name: Speed-limit record
E01.studentText: The speed limit on this stretch is 50 km/h.

E02.name: Mass of car A
E02.studentText: Mass of blue car A: m_A = 1000 kg.

E03.name: Mass of van B
E03.studentText: Mass of gray van B: m_B = 1500 kg.

E04.name: Braking displacement of A
E04.studentText: Displacement of A from the start of braking to impact: s_A = 25 m.

E05.name: Shared skid after impact
E05.studentText: After impact the two vehicles slid 6 m together.

E06.name: Recorder event-time summary
E06.studentText: The recorder video is damaged, but event timestamps remain and can be used to check the sequence.

E07.name: Time from braking to impact for A
E07.studentText: Time from the start of A’s braking to impact: Δt_A = 2.5 s.

E08.name: Magnitude of A’s deceleration
E08.studentText: Magnitude of A’s braking deceleration: a_A = 8 m/s² (absolute value).

E09.name: Magnitude of B’s deceleration
E09.studentText: Magnitude of B’s braking deceleration: a_B = 2 m/s².

E10.name: Delay before B starts braking
E10.studentText: Relative to A starting to brake, B’s braking starts 1.5 s later.

E11.name: Magnitude of the shared deceleration
E11.studentText: Magnitude of the shared post-impact deceleration: a_c = 3 m/s².

E12.name: Collision-model assumption
E12.studentText: A one-dimensional perfectly inelastic collision is assumed (a common speed after impact).

E13.name: Calculated result: speed of A
E13.studentText: From the student calculation: about 20 m/s before A braked, and about 0 m/s just before impact.

E14.name: Calculated result: B’s speed at impact
E14.studentText: From the student calculation: B’s speed at the instant of impact is about 10 m/s.

E15.name: Calculated result: B’s initial speed and gap
E15.studentText: From the student calculation: about 12 m/s before B braked; initial clear gap about 4 m.

alpha.title: Alpha motion model
alpha.prompt: Using E04, E07, and E08, find A’s speed before braking, v_A0, and A’s speed just before impact.

beta.title: Beta collision analysis
beta.prompt: Using the masses, the shared skid, and the perfectly inelastic assumption, find the common speed after impact and B’s speed at the instant of impact.

gamma.title: Gamma energy check
gamma.prompt: Estimate the mechanical-energy loss in the collision model (order of magnitude).

delta.title: Delta relative motion
delta.prompt: Find B’s speed before braking and the initial clear gap. Note: 29 m is only the critical initial gap for this problem’s parameters.

revealSummary.headline: Answer key: lead driver A
points: A’s speed before braking reconstructs to 20 m/s = 72 km/h, which contradicts the explicit claim of “not over 50 km/h”.
B was about 12 m/s = 43.2 km/h before braking and was not speeding in the model; the initial clear gap was about 4 m.
29 m is the critical initial gap under this problem’s fixed parameters, not a universal safe following distance.
A cat or small animal is supported only by testimony. The physics calculation does not prove that A saw it.
This vote only decides the conflict between the speed-limit statement and the model. It does not decide legal liability.
